title: Aeropuerto Arturo Merino Benítez 29 — FINAL v2
subtitle: Post-Incident — Final Interaction / Resolution Attempt
classification: Attorney Work Product — Privileged and Confidential

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: Final post-incident interaction. Includes supplemental recording (STG_29_att).
Diego orchestrates creation of a generic, falsified 'carta de desembarque' using off-book channels.
Document routed through Sales (Ventas) rather than Legal/Security; template is for flight cancellations, not denied boarding.
Diego admits no one writing the document was present at the event ('nadie estuvo en el hecho').
Passenger explicitly raises race/national-origin discrimination ('por mi raza? porque son inmigrantes?').
LATAM staff confirm passenger has been placed in a restricted category and cannot fly, without due process.
Passenger demands refund under CACH Art. 133, LATAM offers only rebooking on another airline.
